newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK XIOSBANK TO TRADE WITH NO PRICE LIMIT-BOURSE.
newsitem.headline: GREEK XIOSBANK TO TRADE WITH NO PRICE LIMIT-BOURSE.

text.p: The Athens bourse removed the daily volatility limit for shares of recently listed Xiosbank, it said in a statement.
The bourse also decided to eschew the staging session for Xiosbank shares. Xiosbank shares will start trading in regular session.
The staging session lasts from 1030 local (0730 GMT) through 1045 local (0745 GMT). It is followed by the regular session which ends at 1330 local (1030 GMT).

Xiosbank shares traded with a 20 percent limit on Tuesday following overwhelming buy interest on Monday which resulted in a break down in the bourse's electronic trading system. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
